mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact identities for the pure-electric neutral-current first variation, polytropic EOS and Newtonian hydrostatic profile, all-exterior gate ratio and cubic derivative, finite-resource controls and an inner-gate countercontrol.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy rational functions, symbolic positive real variables and integer powers in bounded endpoint/integral controls; no floating approximation.
mathematics.conventions: Signature -+++, c=1 only in covariant frame identities; physical c retained in EOS and Newtonian comparison; n is polytropic index, n_s is species number density; gate is inherited conditionally from frozen principal analysis.
inputs: Four immutable source snapshots and their source_manifest.json hashes

bounds.symbolic_identities: Displayed general algebraic identities; sign proofs remain analytic in PROOF.md
bounds.interior_minimum_control: n=5999/1000, eta=1/100, x0=1/1000000; exact derivative signs, no approximate cubic roots
bounds.resource_scope: One small deterministic exact calculation; wall cap 30 seconds, log cap 1 MiB; cooperative numerical-library thread cap one

non_claims: Finite controls do not replace the universal analytic proof.
No exact coupled metric solution, microscopic carrier, source match, nonlinear stability or uniform vacuum hyperbolicity.
An exact Newtonian profile with exact local EOS gate is not an exact covariant background.
